title: centaurea spina-badia subsp. shuttleworthii
intro: Centaurea spina-badia subsp. shuttleworthii, commonly known as Shuttleworth's knapweed, is a perennial plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Centaurea spina-badia subsp. shuttleworthii include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids, are responsible for the therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities.
